notes.title: Sourdough starter — feeding diary
notes.content:
Feeding ratio: 1:5:5 (starter : flour : water by weight). Each morning I keep some ripe starter, discard the rest, then feed at that ratio and log how it rises.
Jul 22 — kept 20 g starter, fed 100 g flour + 100 g water. Rose to double in 6 h at 70°F, domed top.
Jul 23 — kept 20 g starter, fed 100 g flour + 100 g water. Doubled in 5 h at 72°F, lots of big bubbles.
